title: Criticism over candidacy and 'Wermuth appendage' characterisation
description: When Meyer announced her joint candidacy with Cedric Wermuth for the SP presidency, she faced criticism from political opponents, including being characterised dismissively and as a mere 'appendage' of Wermuth. Meyer publicly rejected the framing, noting that the SP district of Winterthur grew under her co-leadership.

title: Public dispute with Ueli Maurer over taxation of the wealthy
description: Meyer, then a member of the Finance Commission, called statements by then Federal Councillor Ueli Maurer 'an affront,' arguing he questioned whether taxation according to economic capacity should apply to billionaires. The exchange reflects her broader stance on wealth taxation and tax competition.

title: Criticism from the political right over nuclear-energy debate
description: The right-wing magazine Weltwoche published commentary criticising Meyer's positions in the debate over nuclear power, accusing her of a selective view of democracy. The piece reflects partisan criticism rather than any established wrongdoing.
